3gpp-platforms.description: 5G-MAG maintains a fork of open5gs for the development and adaptation of 5GC network functions to support other Reference Tools.
5G-MAG maintains a fork of srsRAN_Project for the development and adaptation of NG-RAN procedures to support other Reference Tools.
5G-MAG maintains a fork of srsRAN_4G for the development and adaptation of NG-RAN procedures to support other Reference Tools.

3gpp-platforms.display_name: 5G-MAG's fork of srsRAN (discontinued version prior to srsRAN_4G)
3gpp-platforms.description: Fork of the discontinued srsRAN suite, kept for reference. Superseded by srsRAN_4G for LTE and by rt-srsRAN_Project for 5G NR.

5g-broadcast.description: This repository holds an implementation of the MBMS Middleware for Android.

This repository holds an MBMS Modem, which main task is to convert a 5G BC input signal (received either as live I/Q raw data from the SDR or as prerecorded SDR sample file) to multicast IP packets on the output.
This repository holds a standalone 5G Broadcast transmitter.

5g-broadcast.display_name: 5G Broadcast Transmitter for QRD and CRD
5g-broadcast.description: This repository holds an extension of an MBMS-enabled eNodeB tailored to operate as a 5G Broadcast transmitter compatible with Qualcomm Reference Design (QRD) and QRC devices. In addition, System Information Blocks relevant for Emergency Alerts (e.g. SIB12) can be transmitted.
This repository holds example projects that make use of other 5G-MAG repositories or provide additional functionalities to test and implement new features for MBMS: FLUTE ffmpeg.

MBMS Gateway for an LTE-based 5G Terrestrial Broadcast deployment: takes content from the BM-SC and delivers it onto the M1-U bearer, driving the MBMS session lifecycle towards the MME over Sm (GTPv2-C).
BM-SC for MBMS user services: ingests content over xMB (TS 26.348), announces it, and delivers it with FLUTE under the TS 26.346 profile.
MBMS client: reads the service announcement, reassembles FLUTE objects from the bearer, and republishes them to a local player as an HLS or DASH presentation. Supersedes rt-mbms-mw.
Receive-side web application: plays what the MBMS client received over the air, and shows the modem's radio state, the decoded system information and any cell broadcast warning. Supersedes rt-wui.
Content provider portal: provisions xMB (TS 26.348) services and sessions on the BM-SC, and drives the transmitter's and MBMS Gateway's own control interfaces.

emergency-alerts.description: Implementation of Public Warning System (PWS) alerts over 5G Broadcast.

Cell Broadcast Centre for the Public Warning System: accepts a warning message from an alert originator and emits it to the MME over SBc-AP, so it reaches handsets as ETWS or CMAS. Independent of any MBMS bearer.

5gms.description: This repository holds applications that can be used to test and demonstrate other 5G-MAG Reference Tools related to 5GMS. Current applications available include: 5GMSd-Aware Application; Exo DVB-I Player.
The 5GMS Media Session Handler is a 5GMS Client component that forms part of the 5G Media Services framework as defined in ETSI TS 126.501.
The 5GMS Media Stream Handler is a 5GMS client component that forms part of the 5G Media Services framework as defined in ETSI TS 126.501.

The 5GMS Common Library is an Android library that includes models and helper classes used within the different client-side Android applications such as the 5GMSd-Aware Application, 5GMSd Media Stream Handler and the 5GMSd Media Session Handler.
The 5GMS Application Function (AF) is a Network Function that forms part of the 5G Media Services framework as defined in ETSI TS 126.501.
The 5GMS Application Server (AS) is a Network Function that forms part of the 5G Media Streaming framework as defined in ETSI TS 126.501.
This repository provides multiple tools to interact with the 5GMS Application Function: Command Line Interface Tool; Management UI; Postman Collection; QoE Metrics Reporting UI.

This repository holds example projects that make use of other 5G-MAG repositories or provide additional functionalities to test and implement new features for 5GMS: 5G Media Streaming - Docker Compose Setup; Express Mock AF.
Tools to collect and analyze CMCD (Common Media Client Data) v2 locally and across different cloud providers.

5g-mbs.description: 5G-MAG maintains a fork of open5gs for the development and adaptation of 5GC network functions to support other Reference Tools.
Reference Tools: This repository is related to "5G Multicast Broadcast Services"
This repository is related to: 5G Multicast Broadcast Services
Reference Tools: This repository is related to "5G Multicast Broadcast Services"
Web control portal playing the MBS Application Provider role (3GPP TS 26.502): provisions MBS User Services at Nmb10 towards the MBSF and pushes content at Nmb8 towards the MBSTF.
UE-side MBS Client (3GPP TS 26.502): receives the MBS-4-MC announcement carousel and FLUTE object delivery, and exposes the received services to applications over the MBS-6 and MBS-7 local APIs.
Dashboard playing the MBS-Aware Application role (3GPP TS 26.502) against rt-mbs-client: lists announced services, activates and deactivates reception, and inspects received objects.

Service-consumer library implementing the MB-SMF side of Nmbsmf_TMGI and Nmbsmf_MBSSession (3GPP TS 29.532), vendored as a subproject inside the MBSF as an alternative to provisioning the 5GC directly.
5G-MAG maintains a fork of srsRAN_4G, adapted for 5G Multicast Broadcast Services (MBS) support.
5G-MAG maintains a fork of srsRAN Project, adapted for 5G Multicast Broadcast Services (MBS) support.

5g-core.description: This repository contains a collection of reusable service consumer libraries designed to interact with the 5GC Network Functions using service interfaces.

6g-testbed.description: A framework for measuring and analyzing AI/LLM service traffic patterns under various network conditions, designed to support 3GPP SA4 6G Media Study contributions.
A web dashboard and REST API for applying, creating and scheduling network impairment profiles (delay, jitter, loss, bandwidth caps) with the 6G-Testbed's netemu.

ai-ml.description: This repository holds code related to the implementation of the AI/ML evaluation framework as defined in 3GPP SA4 TR 26.847 (Release 19).

beyond-2d.description: This project holds code related to the evaluation framework for the Feasibility Study on Beyond 2D Video (FS_Beyond2D) in 3GPP TSG SA WG4 (SA4). This study is based on work item description (WID) SP-240479 New SID on Feasibility Study on Beyond 2D Video, and the study will result in technical report TR 26.956.

avatar.description: This repository holds reference MPEG ARF content for real time avatar communication.
This repository supports the development of a reference framework for avatar communication. The goal is to demonstrate WebRTC communication using the MPEG ARF and related animation compression.
Sample OpenXR tracker for ARF avatar animation in Unity
Reference Tools: This repository is related to "Conversational Avatar Real-Time Communications"

dvb-i.description: This repository holds applications that can be used to test and demonstrate other 5G-MAG Reference Tools related to 5GMS. Current applications available include: 5GMSd-Aware Application; Exo DVB-I Player.
A browser DVB-I client that discovers a service list, presents its channels with their content guide, and plays them, per ETSI TS 103 770.
A native Android DVB-I client: it discovers a service list, presents its channels with their content guide, and plays them with Media3 ExoPlayer, per ETSI TS 103 770.
Publishes a DVB-I service list and its content guide, and gives an editor for maintaining them, per ETSI TS 103 770.
Answers DVB-I client queries with a list of Service List Entry Points, per ETSI TS 103 770 V1.2.1 clause 5.1.3.2.
Runnable examples that bring the DVB-I repositories up together on one machine, publishing and playing a service list per ETSI TS 103 770.

content-delivery.description: This is an implementation of a FLUTE server and client.
A media origin server component for Content Delivery Protocols testing (JavaScript/TypeScript web application). No public description has been published on GitHub yet.
An Android test app and a laptop test rig that check every delivery method of rt-media-origin arrives on a phone and plays as configured.
Reference implementation of a CMMF Encoder according to ETSI TS 103 973.

network-apis.description: This repository contains example files and tools in relation to the CAMARA Project

data-collection.description: This repository provides a 5G Data Collection Service Provider library and AF. It can provide the interfaces R1-R6 as per 3GPP TS 26.531 (See Clause 4.2). The default Application Function implementation here implements some of the data reports and events defined in 3GPP TS 26.531, 3GPP TS 26.532 and 3GPP TS 29.517.

v3c.description: This project provides a Unity package to decode and play V3C contents in Unity, using the MPEG V3C Immersive Platform - Decoder Plugin. Also provided in that repository are V-PCC and MIV synthesizers plugins needed for the rendering of the V3C contents.
This project contains the entrypoints for decoding and viewing MPEG Immersive Video (MIV) and Video Point Cloud Compression (V-PCC) related to the MPEG V3C Immersive Platform.
This folder contains the files to configure and test the V3CImmersivePlatform - Unity Player application.
Example V3C content and helper files for testing the encoding, delivery and rendering pipeline.

xr.description: The XR Unity Player is an interactive and XR-capable glTF scene viewer implemented in Unity3D. It supports glTF extensions specified in the MPEG-I Scene Description framework (ISO/IEC 23090-14).
Fast glTF loader extensions for immersive media assets in Unity.

This repository provides media pipelines implementations supporting the 5G-MAG Reference Tools XR Player Unity 3D project. Media pipelines are plugins for the XR Player's media player implementation of the Media Access Functions API (MAF) defined in ISO/IEC 23090-14.
This repository provides reference content for testing and demos with the XR Player.
This Blender add-on adds support for MPEG_* glTF extensions to the built-in glTF exporter.

developer-tools.description: Tools for 5G-MAG members that support the transition of standards into deployments: tools, rules and working records for going from a specification to a working implementation.

common-tools.description: This repository holds auxiliary tools common to various projects.

vdmc.description: Web-based decoder and player for Dynamic Mesh Coding (V-DMC) content. Repository is new; no public description has been published on GitHub yet.

vops.description: Validates AVC and HEVC video bitstreams against the operation points of 3GPP TS 26.265 (VOPS)
